intent.problem: Separate scans miss changes and recurrence across time.
intent.target_users: Mac owners and local security reviewers.

safety.reason: Read existing evidence, preserve uncertainty, and never remediate the machine.

product.benefit: Connect evidence over time and inspect what supports each concern.
product.problem: Repeated scans can confuse observations with actual activity.
product.how_it_works: Queries recent local security logs, retains diagnostic metadata across runs, and publishes source receipts and coverage without inspecting OS files.
product.input: Output folder. Recent Mac unified logs are queried automatically.
product.output: Diagnostic log metadata, source receipts, coverage, and saved reports.
product.target_users: Mac owners and local security reviewers.
product.simulation_type: Synthetic evidence is used only in tests; runs inspect the local Mac.
